visualReview.notes: Compared the southeast merchant lettering, three curved parapets and wraparound street awnings with the original Queensland State Library photograph. The three rear gables, loading doors and central roof vents follow the state register.

sharedSurfaceReview.notes: Inspected the galvanized roof and cladding, painted metal lettering, timber canopy supports, window sash surfaces and raised loading floor. Shared geographic placement loaded and unloaded.

mediumFiReview.notes: All four detail levels preserve the three parallel roofs, curved street parapet and low horizontal canopy. Close-up geometry adds original painted lettering, roof seams and differentiated windows, loading doors and step profiles.

terrain.grade: The original 200 metre Copernicus GLO-30 field ranges from 4.085 to 11.9479 m EGM2008, with a Landsborough Street datum of 8.7623 m. The canopy supports and masonry stumps meet the native grade. The higher Caroline Street ground obscures part of the shallower stair.

geographicReview.notes: The 30.92 by 47.67 metre roof envelope aligns with OpenStreetMap way 1213228785 and the Normanton Visitor Information Centre. The ochre parapet follows Landsborough Street and the returning canopy fronts Caroline Street.

fidelityReview.scope: The standing timber and iron Burns Philp store in Normanton, including the three roof bays, decorative Landsborough Street facade, two street awnings and rear loading entrances.
fidelityReview.notes: The standing store follows the mapped footprint and statutory roof and elevation description. Paint tones, individual window profiles and the side loading grade are approximated.

imageryReview.notes: The Qualla gallery was checked first. The exact c. 1920 reference is the State Library of Queensland original negative 142299, cataloged as out of copyright and free to use without permission.

validation.sharedCaptureScope: Inspected the three street parapets, the hip seam on the street corner, doors and steps, the inland loading elevation, all four detail levels and the original terrain field.

limitations: Draft exterior: approximate photographic proportions and simplified ornament. It is not a survey, photogrammetric reconstruction or approved current geographic replacement.

Queensland Heritage Register entry 602781 specifies the raised floor, roof valleys, central ridge ventilators, window and door stations. The original photograph provides the three decorated parapet curves and profile of the projecting street awnings.
Terrain sampling/contact, geographic alignment and site activation remain pending. Runtime LODs are produced by the registered after-import pipeline and require visual review.
Reference photos remain in the local Qualla corpus; only provenance, paths and hashes are retained here.
